title: A quasi-finite morphism is generically finite
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism which is locally quasi-finite and finite type over a locally Noetherian base is generically finite. The proof examines the generic points of the source over the generic points of the target, uses that quasi-finiteness bounds the fibres to see that the relevant specialisations cannot occur, and concludes that the points in question are generic points of irreducible components of the source, which is the required finiteness of the generic fibre.
